shots.text: Under Pyrrhenhall we fought the thing Ignar had become, the Cinder Tyrant, a giant of grey fire. When it fell, the grey burned off it, and Ignar woke.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Cinder Tyrant collapsing in the caldera, grey-white fire guttering. From the cracked basalt steps a tall black-stone figure with an orange molten heart: Ignar.

shots.text: Someone whispered in my sleep until I forgot what I was. I am awake now. I will burn for you.
shots.speaker: ignar
shots.art_note: Ignar kneeling to Brannoc and the Emberfolk, his heart-light warming their faces.

shots.text: With its Warden awake, the Reach could keep the sea out again. By morning the water had run back down the mountain, and the Emberfolk lit their forges.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Steam clearing off the slopes of Pyrrhenhall, the sea draining away. Emberfolk relighting forges; Ignar standing among them, much taller than anyone.

shots.text: One land back. Five to go. Pack your tools, Spirewright. The Thunder Steppe is next.
shots.speaker: fennick
shots.art_note: Fennick rolling up a tower plan, the lit forges of the Reach behind him.
